# netactuate_firewall_set_related_vms (Data Source)

Reads Firewall Set Related VMs visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_firewall_set_related_vms" "example" {
  mbpkgid = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mbpkgid` (Number) VM package ID whose firewall set relations will be listed.

### Optional

- `disable_interface_id_filter` (Boolean) Disable interface ID filtering when querying related firewall sets.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vms` (List of Object) Firewall set relations for the VM. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `firewall_set_id` (Number)
- `hostname` (String)
- `iata_code` (String)
- `interface_id` (Number)
- `location` (String)
- `mbpkgid` (Number)
- `relation_id` (Number)
- `set_priority` (Number)
